description: Retrieves columns from a specific dashboard, including both widget and filter-level columns.

dashboard_name.description: The name of the dashboard to retrieve columns from.

examples.user_query: What columns are available in the 'Sales Overview' dashboard?
examples.notes: This call retrieves all distinct columns from the 'Sales Overview' dashboard, including widget and filter-level columns. Use this to understand the data structure of the dashboard.

examples.user_query: Can you list the columns in the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard?
examples.notes: This call fetches the columns from the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard. Useful for analyzing the data sources used in the dashboard.

examples.user_query: I need the column details for the 'Customer Insights' dashboard.
examples.notes: This call retrieves all unique columns from the 'Customer Insights' dashboard. Ideal for understanding the data fields used in widgets and filters.
